name: White Warm Balaclava with Merino Wool Lining
description:
White winter balaclava with a warm merino wool lining and two generous faux-fur pom-poms, designed to cover the head, ears, neck, and lower face.

The breathable merino lining helps regulate temperature while retaining warmth. Its adaptable neck section can be worn below the chin or pulled higher across the lower face when extra coverage is needed.

Features and Materials

• 100% merino wool lining offers breathable, temperature-regulating warmth.

• Soft textured outer surface and double-layer construction support comfortable winter protection.

• Two large faux-fur pom-poms give the balaclava a distinctive playful finish.

• Adaptable neck section can rest under the chin or cover more of the lower face.

• Suitable for winter conditions down to approximately −25 °C; factor in wind chill.

• Available in head sizes 44, 46, 48, 50, 52, 54, and 56.

Made in Estonia. The clean white color and matching pom-poms create a softly coordinated cold-weather look.

name: Multifunctional Soft Play Set Baby Gym - Earth Pastel
description:
Multifunctional Soft Play Set Baby Gym is a canvas for your child's creativity. With various shapes and sizes, it offers endless possibilities for imaginative play, construction, and exploration. Watch as your child transforms their ideas into tangible creations, actively enhancing their problem-solving, spatial reasoning, and critical thinking skills. It's a fun way to learn through play.

  • Encourages physical activity

  • Boosts creativity & imagination

  • Helps release excess energy & manage stress

  • Provides sensory stimulation

  • Keeps children off screens

  • Promotes social skills like sharing & collaborating

  • Age group: 0.5 - 5 years

IGLU's gentle, huggable shapes are like buddies for developing a wide range of movement and motor skills in kids. Different shapes help kids boost their coordination and motor skills – from wiggling fingers to crawling, climbing, and exploring heights.

Sharing giggles with siblings, friends, and buddies turbocharges social skills by sparking chats and connections.

Teaming up with parents or pals leads to speedy learning and spotting cool geometric shapes and vivid colors. The endless mix of shapes is like a treasure trove for crafting imaginative worlds – castles, forts, and more.

As kids grow, these shapes morph into excellent tools. Building obstacle courses, playing games, and conquering steps to beds or chairs – the possibilities are endless. Even pets join in the fun, using shapes as toys and adults get crafty – imagine shapes as a trusty computer stand!

  • Very durable – made from HQ foam. Dense yet light foam that holds its shape.

  • Easy clean-up - wipes clean with a wet wipe.

  • Handmade - from sewing to packaging, everything is handmade.

  • Certificates - the blocks get vigorously tested and have received safety certificates in EU, USA, Canada and UK.

  • Made in EU - everything is made from our local Northern Europe facility.

IGLU Soft blocks are made of firm, 100% recyclable high-quality foam with a closed cell structure – soft & super light.  Covered with a tough artificial eco-leather. Shapes are robust, pleasant to the touch, easy to care for, retain shape well, and tested for harmful substances.

IGLU products are CE marked according to EU Directive 88/378 / EEC: Toy Safety, making them absolutely safe for toddlers.

name: White Merino Wool Double Pom-Pom Balaclava
description:
White merino wool balaclava finished with two soft pom-poms, made to keep the head, ears, neck, and lower face protected on cold winter days.

The merino outer layer remains breathable while helping preserve warmth, and the cotton-fleece lining feels soft against the skin. Its flexible neck section can be worn beneath the chin or raised over the lower face.

Features and Materials

• 100% merino wool outer layer with breathable, naturally insulating performance.

• Soft cotton-fleece lining and double-layer construction provide reliable winter comfort.

• Two contrasting pom-poms give the design a cheerful bear-ear silhouette.

• Adjustable neck section can stay below the chin or cover more of the face.

• Suitable for winter when the feels-like temperature is approximately −25 °C to 0 °C; factor in wind chill.

• Available in head sizes 44, 46, 48, 50, 52, 54, and 56.

Made in Estonia. The warm white shade creates a clean, versatile winter look.
